title: [recoverability][observability] The Core lines card says a failed newest drill (part 2 of 105): "failed ...; last passed ..." with its reason as the row's title
prompt:
Read drillMark in web/src/coreLines.ts and the drill rows of web/src/components/home/CoreLines.tsx. After 105, whose GET /api/core-lines gives each `drills` row `last`: its newest drill's own result {at_ms, ok, reason}, or null.

The problem (lead, 11-13). The card still reads a row by its last pass alone: a drill whose newest run failed after its last pass reads "passed ..." in plain, so the person reading Home sees a resource as restorable while its newest restore failed.

Required behaviour.
- web/src/coreLines.ts: a row whose `last` has ok false reads "failed MM-DD HH:MM (<span> ago); last passed MM-DD HH:MM (<span> ago)", or "failed MM-DD HH:MM (<span> ago); never passed" without a pass, and "failed (time unknown); ..." when last.at_ms is null; tone warning; its mark (CoreDrillMark) carries the reason as `detail`. Every other row reads as today, with `detail` "". The words for times and spans are the card's own (sinceWords, spanWords).
- web/src/components/home/CoreLines.tsx shows `detail` as that row's title (hover) when it is not empty; nothing else of the card changes.

Polled-read cost: none (the card reads the answer it already polls).

Files (expected; no other open objective touches them; after 105): web/src/coreLines.ts (drillMark, CoreDrill's `last`, CoreDrillMark's `detail`), web/src/components/home/CoreLines.tsx (the title only), web/test/coreLines.test.ts (a case of its own). About 50 changed lines.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/112.sh. 105's history and answer (its harness exits 2 without `last` in the answer); (1) web/src/coreLines.ts over the real answer says "failed ...; last passed ..." for Database and "failed ...; never passed" for Off-host copy, tone warning, with their reasons as detail, and the passing rows as before. 105, 093 (as 105 changed it), 086, 090, 095 and check-web must still pass.
